messages:
Maya: Heads-up — CTO from Acme asked for console-based rollout controls + analytics for Dedicated customers. They say SDK calls are fine but security team prefers a UI. How should we prioritize API vs Console here?

Aj: my 2c: API-first lets us validate patterns faster, lower engineering surface. :thumbsup:

Beth: Sales — enterprise deal likely contingent on console; impact is high. If we don't ship console they'd walk.

Sam: DevEx — API onboarding friction is the main blocker for PLG. Console helps self-serve. Tradeoff: build console vs improve API docs & templates.

Irene: Design — console MVP could be small: "model pinning + rollout toggle + audit log" — ~5 screens.

Aj: Concern: Console will require auth flows, RBAC, telemetry hooks — maintenance cost high. Rough effort: 6–8 wks cross-team.

Maya: Thinking RICE for options: Reach=Low (enterprise-only), Impact=High, Confidence=Medium, Effort=High -> score ambiguous. Need to quantify.

Beth: Can we do hybrid — API first + a thin console that calls the same APIs? Lower duplication and better for both sales and devs.

Aj: Hybrid is basically API-first with a thin console; still needs UI work but avoids backend duplication. I like this path.

Sam: Suggest launch criteria before we commit: 1) end-to-end provisioning via API; 2) console parity for core flows with RBAC; 3) telemetry surfaced in Console. If those aren't met, hold.

Irene: Also include 3 customer usability sessions in beta. That will validate the console UX for security teams.

Maya: Proposal: run a lightweight RICE table and decide Friday. @Beth can you confirm if the deal timeline is >4 wks? @Aj can you post a rough-effort fence (backend/ui) by EOD?

Beth: Deal timeline is 6 weeks. We have room if we can deliver core console in ~4 weeks.

Aj: Will post breakdown by EOD. Lean approach looks like: 3 backend sprints + 2 UI sprints (parallel where possible).

Maya: Decision rule: if RICE scores within 15% we default to API-first + thin console. OK with everyone?

Sam: +1

Irene: +1

Beth: +1 :tada:

ops-bot: Reminder: add epic "console-enterprise-rollouts" to the roadmap board and tag stakeholders.

Maya: Thanks all — I'll synthesize the RICE table and share the decision Friday.
